teacher_forced_action_fit_audit.interpretation: The current checkpoint closely matches one-step expert actions on these sampled in-distribution observations in absolute terms; this does not explain or override 0/50 held-out and 0/5 zero-wait closed-loop results, and does not prove causal sufficiency.

action_chunk_horizon_fit_audit.interpretation: No evidence of error growth across the predicted chunk on these in-sample demonstrations. This does not resolve why strict held-out and zero-wait closed-loop success remain 0; closed-loop state distribution, execution dynamics, and generalization remain untested by this audit.

This closes the raw-data conversion parity gap but does not verify post-preprocessing model tensors or explain closed-loop failure.
